text:
alex: Ok team — quick thread to lock down scope for enterprise audit log + retention work after the sales asks. Two pilots want 5y+ retention and a mechanical export path. I want a proposal for MVP vs. enterprise add-on.

maria: Agree we can't support arbitrary 7y cold storage in MVP. Proposal: MVP = per-workspace retention settings (30/90/365 days), immutable append-only audit events, and export API (bulk CSV/NDJSON) + S3 connector. Enterprise add-on = managed long-term archival (lifecycle to glacier) + per-tenant cold retention.

sam: Security/GRC angle: we need chain-of-custody and tamper-evidence for archived logs for SOC2/ISO evidence. If export API exists, exports must be signed and have audit metadata (who requested, key id). Also BYOK for export encryption is required for a few customers.

jordan: From sales — there are two deals that will sign if we can guarantee 5y retention and BYOK. They also asked for automated monthly export to their S3. They're open to an add-on fee.

maria: Implementation notes: exporting to arbitrary S3 requires KMS integration for SSE-KMS or customer-provided key. For MVP we can support server-side encryption with our KMS and the S3 connector; BYOK support can be gated to enterprise because it needs HSM/KMS work and rotation handling.

alex: Can we list launch criteria and a minimal timeline? I'm thinking: 2 sprint MVP (retention UI, enforcement, export API, S3 connector), enterprise phase (BYOK, signed exports, rotation docs) in 3 additional sprints.

liz: Ops: retention enforcement implies background deletion jobs and proofs. We need deletion audit events and dry-run deletion tooling and alerts if backfill fails. Also quota implications — long retention raises storage costs that product ops must surface.

sam: Also add: retention policy must be immutable for a closed window once set for compliance customers (e.g., one-week lock). We should log policy changes as audit events.

alex: Good. Draft launch checklist (short):
- retention config UI + API (workspace-level)
- enforcement + deletion audit events
- export API (bulk) + scheduled export to S3
- S3 connector with server-side encryption (our KMS)
- signed export metadata (basic)
- docs + runbook for sales/SE

maria: Add test criteria: end-to-end export test to S3, retention enforcement test (create events older than threshold -> ensure deletion), and an integration test for signed export metadata verification.

jordan: For negotiation with customers: offer 1) 365-day default on hosted, 2) 5y retention as paid add-on with monthly storage surcharge + annual commitment, 3) BYOK as separate professional services/enterprise feature. This buys us time to implement BYOK properly.

sam: Compliance owners: need an evidence pack for SOC2 review — include sample exports with metadata, retention policy history, and deletion logs. That should be part of enterprise docs.

alex: Decision: ship MVP as product-matter feature (workspace retention + export + S3 connector) and treat BYOK/7y archival as enterprise phase. I'll add canary flag so we can enable early for pilots.

liz: One more: add telemetry for per-tenant storage usage and alert on unusual growth. Ops needs a billing export to reconcile costs.

alex: Next actions: maria to write implementation RFC + rough estimate, sam to capture security requirements for export signing and BYOK, jordan to draft customer offer terms. I'll own rollout plan and launch criteria. Can we get RFC by EOD Wed?

maria: Yes, I'll draft RFC and include a minimal API spec and config sample:```
POST /v1/workspaces/{id}/retention
body: {"days": 365, "immutable_lock_days": 7}
```

sam: I'll add KMS/BYOK requirements and evidence checklist.

jordan: I'll prepare pricing language and pilot addendum template.

security-bot: Automated note: created task SEC-1423 (export signing requirements) assigned to sam.

alex: Perfect. Thanks everyone :thumbsup: We'll reconvene after RFCs.
